cover: WordPress for editors, static pages for patients

slides.title: Staff liked editing it
slides.body: An endoscopy center ran its site on WordPress. Editors were happy. Patients waited on every page load.

slides.title: Patients never touch it
slides.body: Pages are built ahead of time from WordPress content. Visitors get plain HTML.

slides.title: Publishing is still one button
slides.body: A small plugin waits ninety seconds after a publish, so ten quick saves become one rebuild.

slides.title: A CMS outage stays backstage
slides.body: If WordPress is down during a build, the build fails and the previous site stays up.

slides.title: Content is checked first
slides.body: A renamed field stops the build with a clear error, so a wrong page never goes live.
